welcome.connections:
Welcome to DB Explorer.
Start by adding a database connection (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite).
[New connection](command:dbexplorer.addConnection)
[Import from tnsnames.ora](command:dbexplorer.importTns)
Then press Ctrl+Alt+J for all actions.
welcome.history: No queries yet. Run a statement and it will appear here.
cfg.pageSize: Number of rows fetched per batch in the grid.
cfg.maxTreeObjects: Maximum number of objects listed per category in the Schema Browser.
cfg.oracleClientLibDir: Oracle Instant Client folder (Thick mode). Empty = Thin mode (no client required).
cfg.enableDbmsOutput: Enable DBMS_OUTPUT and show its output after each execution.
cfg.keymap: DB Explorer shortcut set in SQL files. Customizable in Keyboard Shortcuts (search: dbexplorer).
cfg.keymap.standard: Ctrl+Alt+Enter / S / X / D / T: no conflict with VS Code
cfg.keymap.toad: F9, F5, Ctrl+E, F4, Ctrl+F9 (override VS Code shortcuts)
ext.description: Multi-database SQL explorer and client (Oracle with tnsnames.ora, SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL) inspired by Toad: Schema Browser, query history, results grid, Explain Plan, DDL, export.
cfg.idleTimeoutMinutes: Close a connection after this many minutes of inactivity (0 = never). Uncommitted changes are rolled back if "rollbackOnTimeout" is on.
cfg.rollbackOnTimeout: Roll back uncommitted changes when the idle timeout hits. If off, the connection stays open while changes are pending.
cfg.transactionTimeoutMinutes: Automatically roll back uncommitted changes after this many minutes (0 = never), even if you are active.
cfg.queryTimeoutSeconds: Maximum execution time of a statement in seconds (default 600 = 10 minutes, 0 = no limit). When reached, the statement is cancelled (Oracle, PostgreSQL and MySQL; SQLite cannot be interrupted); if the database does not stop it within 4 seconds the connection is reset.
cfg.prefetchMetadata: Scan table and column names in the background to make code completion instant, even on very large databases (separate connection, throttled).
cfg.metadataConnection: Use dedicated connections for metadata scans and completion lookups, so they never block your own queries (uses up to 2 extra database sessions per connection).
cmd.importTns: DB Explorer: Import connections from tnsnames.ora…
cfg.colorEditors: Color the tab and the left edge of SQL editors with the color of their connection.
cfg.connectionInWindowTitle: Show the active connection (user@schema (name)) at the start of the VS Code window title. Edits the user setting "window.title" and restores it when turned off or when no connection is active. If you use the Command Center (default on Windows), turn it off ("window.commandCenter": false) to see the window title text.
cfg.compareMaxRows: Maximum number of rows read from each query when comparing results.
cfg.blankLineSeparatesStatements: Like Toad, a blank line ends a statement that has no terminating ";" (not inside parentheses or PL/SQL blocks). The statement under the cursor — run, explained, optimized, used for completion aliases — stops there.
cmd.codeActions: DB Explorer: Show actions at the cursor
cfg.notifyUncommitted: Show a reminder with Commit / Rollback buttons the first time a data-modifying statement leaves a transaction open (manual commit mode).
cfg.previewAffectedRows: Before an UPDATE or DELETE, count the rows it will affect (SELECT COUNT(*) with the same WHERE) and show it in the log.
cfg.confirmRowsThreshold: Ask for confirmation before an UPDATE / DELETE affecting at least this many rows (0 = never ask because of the count). A statement without WHERE always asks.
cfg.confirmOnProduction: Always ask for confirmation before an UPDATE / DELETE on a connection coloured red (production).
cmd.compareSchemas: Compare two schemas (and generate a sync script)…
cmd.favorite.add: Save the statement as a favorite
cmd.toAnsiJoin: Convert Oracle joins to ANSI JOIN
cfg.groupBySchema: Schema Browser: list the schemas (users) of the connection and browse their objects, instead of showing only the current schema.
cmd.diagnoseDuplicates: Duplicate detector (add the keys of every table to the SELECT)
cfg.clearLogOnRun: Clear the Script / Messages and Errors tabs at the start of each execution (otherwise they keep accumulating, one separator per run; use the Clear button).
cmd.saveSnippet: Save the selection as a template
cfg.onScriptError: What to do when a statement of a script fails.
cfg.showEditorBadge: Show the connection (and PRODUCTION) at the end of the first line of SQL editors.
cfg.snippets: Your own query templates (name, body in VS Code snippet syntax).
cfg.showAllMaxRows: Maximum number of rows loaded by the "Show all" button of the results grid (0 = no limit).
cfg.alwaysShowToolsAndHelp: Always show the Tools / Settings and Help views in the sidebar (otherwise they are opened from the actions palette).
cfg.inlineErrors: Show errors and warnings in the SQL editor: tinted line and greyed message at the end of the line.
cfg.liveChecks: Instant checks while typing (no database needed): unbalanced parentheses, UPDATE / DELETE without WHERE.
cfg.scanOnConnect: Scan the whole schema (objects and columns, for code completion) as soon as you connect. Off by default: the cache is read from disk and the scan only starts when you actually use completion or after a structure change (CREATE / ALTER / DROP).
